{{Top|leg}}
'''Trundle cars''' were small vehicles used to transport passengers in the [[Arkadianate]] capital city of [[Calimondretta]] on the icy planet of [[Syned]]. Each had an airtight cabin capable of carrying four passengers. In [[1032 BBY/Legends|1032 BBY]], the [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] leader [[Brigadier]] [[Jarrow Rusher]] considered transporting the 1,700 passengers aboard his troopship [[Diligence (New Sith Wars)|''Diligence'']] but ruled that out due to the logistical problems entailed by the operation. Instead, the Arkadinate ruler [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Arkadia Calimondra]] opted to provide an [[Icecrawler/Legends|icecrawler]] to carry the refugees.
